title: x402 Paywall: overview film
description: Paid content for people and AI agents. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 55 seconds: x402 Paywall for TYPO3 v14. A price in the page properties; Test without spending money; Revenue and a setup check. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: Selling one article or one API call means accounts, card forms and fees. AI agents cannot fill in a checkout at all.
x402 Paywall sells TYPO3 pages and API routes for small USDC amounts.
Switch the paywall on in the page properties, and set a price.
The simulator requests a paid page and decodes the HTTP 402 answer.
The dashboard shows settled revenue and checks the setup of each site.
x402 Paywall. People pay from their wallet, agents through HTTP headers.
